fees.description:
$8.18 (inc. GST) Special Meter Read fee. This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary.
You must pay us any charges your distributor imposes on us in relation to services performed by your distributor (or anyone else) at your supply address. For details on additional charges that may apply, visit www.covau.com.au/additionalfees
$75.02 (inc. GST) fee may apply when your property is disconnected. This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary.
$75.02 (inc. GST) fee may apply when your property is reconnected. This fee is passed through from your distributor and may vary.
$2.75 (inc. GST) Direct Credit or Debit dishonour payment fee.
A 0.73% (inc. GST) fee may apply to payments made by debit and credit cards.

gasContract.terms: For full terms and conditions applicable to this energy offer, please visit www.covau.com.au/terms or contact CovaU on 1300 689 866.

discounts.description: Discounts applied to GST inclusive gas usage charges.
Stay on this plan for 6 months from the date you transferred to CovaU and we'll credit $50 to your account.
Stay on this plan for 12 months from the date you transferred to CovaU and we'll credit an extra $50 to your account.

gasContract.variation: We may vary your rates in line with our Terms and Conditions at any time by written notice to you. Notice will be given at least 5 business days prior to the variation.

eligibility.information: This offer is available to new residential customers only who are located within the relevant distribution area. For more details about the eligibility criteria, please contact CovaU on 1300 689 866.

gasContract.onExpiryDescription: The agreement continues until terminated by you or us in accordance with our Market Retail Terms & Conditions
